description: Choose the business name shown inside your SMS text, e.g. "Il tuo codice <name> è…" (letters, digits and spaces, max 20; the sender stays a phone number) and optionally your site domain (e.g. example.com) for links. Ask the human first. It goes to review: usually decided in seconds, brand-like names wait for a Telmian reviewer. Real verification codes need it approved.
name: set_sender_profile
